messages:
maya: Rollout complete for canary group A -> v2026-03-22-a. Starting post-deploy smoke now. Please watch eu1 prefills and synth probes for 15m.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment finished. Traffic routed: 5% canary -> v2026-03-22-a. Running synth suite: prefill, embed, kvprobe. Links: https://deploy.redwood.internal/runs/1798889001

deploy-bot: Synth result (eu1): prefill-kvprobe p95 increased to 1.8s (baseline 0.42s). 502s observed: 6 in last 5m. Threshold for alert: >3 502s/5m.

leo: seeing same in dashboards. p50 ok, p95 spike looks correlated with small fanout bursts. stack: gateway -> inference-proxy -> kvcache.

anika: pulled a quick trace. looks like kvcache sometimes returning 502s when cold-starts happen in eu1 pool during the canary. Not seeing model OOMs.

priya: timeline? did we change kvclient version?

maya: no kvclient change. This was runtime + small routing tweak to increase canary instances.

leo: suggestion: increase prefill sampling for eu1 and pin the canary to v2026-03-21-b for eu1 while we triage. Keep global canary traffic as-is.

anika: +1. If we pin eu1 to previous hot cache snapshot that should avoid the cold tails. I can apply a temporary route override.

sre-bot: Perftrace saved: https://traces.redwood.internal/t/89a3b2 (token: quicklook). Alerting: incident created #INC-2026-113.

deploy-bot: Command suggestion to pin route (run from orchestration):
```
redwood route update --region eu1 --service prefill --pin-version v2026-03-21-b --reason "postdeploy p95 spike"
```

priya: agree with pin as short mitigation. If 502s continue after pin+prefill-sample-up, we should plan rollback of the canary. My threshold: persist >3 502s/10m after mitigation -> rollback.

maya: anika, can you run the route update and raise prefill sampling to 10x for eu1 for 20m? leo, can you monitor p95 and error-rate?

anika: on it. running the pin now and bumping sampler.

anika: done. Route pinned in eu1 to v2026-03-21-b at 1798889065. Prefill sampling x10 for 20m.

leo: dashboards look better already, p95 dropped to 0.5s in last 2m, 502s count now 0 in last 5m.

priya: good. keep the pin for 30m then either unpin or escalate to rollback if regression returns.

maya: documenting: pinned eu1 -> v2026-03-21-b; mitigated with increased prefill sampling. Follow-up: investigate cold-start behavior of kvcache when scaling canary instances. Owner: anika + infra.

anika: logging a ticket now: INF-2026-492 "kvcache cold-start 502s during small fanout bursts". adding traces and deploy links.

deploy-bot: Synth suite re-run scheduled at 1798889180 (in 60s). Will post results.

maya: thanks all. will hold global rollout until team gives green. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Synth re-run results: prefill p95 eu1 = 0.48s, 502s = 0. Next scheduled check in 10m.

leo: declaring this mitigated for now. keep incident open until INF ticket has first triage.

priya: +1. If any regression after unpin, execute rollback plan: rollback canary -> stop new canary allocations, notify infra on-call.

maya: ack. closing thread for active coordination, will update when INF-2026-492 has first triage.
